$comment: WALTEUR required-tools manifest. Parser: walteur-kit/hooks/tool-readiness.sh:63-83. Schema: {tools:[{tool,required(bool),discipline,install}]}. required:true => HARD fail-closed floor (exit 2 if absent). required:false => recorded, never blocks. ast-grep is OPT-IN-REQUIRED: required:false so its absence is a LOUD SKIP inside resilience-lint/anti-slop-ui (grep floor underneath), never a hard dependency — keeping the 'machinery is optional, the discipline is not' law intact.

tools.install: brew install ast-grep | cargo install ast-grep | npm i -g @ast-grep/cli
tools.fallback: zero-dep grep/awk path in each gate (LOUD SKIP when ast-grep absent)
tools.note: Opt-in-required: present => AUTHORITATIVE AST pass (gate exits 2 on a finding). Absent => LOUD SKIP to the grep floor, never silent-green and never a hard fail.

tools.install: preinstalled on macOS/Linux; else brew/apt install curl
tools.role: queries OSV.dev for MAL-* malicious-package advisories on new deps / candidate MCP servers
tools.fallback: LOUD SKIP (recorded) when curl absent OR api.osv.dev unreachable; WALTEUR_OSV=strict => fail-closed (exit 2)
tools.note: P-OSV opt-in: present+online => HARD fail-closed on a MAL-* advisory. Offline => recorded SKIP (never PROVEN-SAFE). Selftest is hermetic/offline via OSV_FIXTURE.

tools.role: authoritative-when-present: runs Knip, observes real exit (unused files/exports/deps)
tools.fallback: LOUD SKIP when absent; WALTEUR_DEADCODE_STRICT=1 => FAIL on a JS/TS surface
tools.note: ISC, offline, JS/TS only. From audit-tools.json intake (S008 skill fix).

tools.fallback: LOUD SKIP when absent; WALTEUR_DBHEALTH_STRICT=1 => FAIL on an ORM surface
tools.note: MIT. Pin exact version + vendor tarball (new/solo-maintainer). From audit-tools.json (S008).

tools.install: external CLI only (AGPL); pip/pipx install per repo
tools.role: authoritative-when-present: runs MEDUSA scan, observes findings/exit (CVE/secrets/injection/MCP-poison)
tools.fallback: LOUD SKIP when absent; WALTEUR_SECSCAN_STRICT=1 => FAIL on a source surface
tools.note: AGPL — run as external CLI, NEVER vendor source. From audit-tools.json (S008).
